scripts.start: npm run build && npm run run
scripts.docker: docker system prune && docker build -t automation . &&  docker run -p 3000:3000 automation
scripts.docker-push: npm run build && docker system prune -f && docker build -t automation:${npm_config_tag} . && docker tag automation:${npm_config_tag} vloglife643/automation:${npm_config_tag} && docker push vloglife643/automation:${npm_config_tag}
scripts.resolve-permission: ls -l node_modules/.bin/tsc && chmod +x node_modules/.bin/tsc && npm run build
